backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for an NFT marketplace on ICP, managing collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minted tokens with role-based access control (admin/user) and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three features related to fixing the indefinitely-hanging admin permissions check to their implementation files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering pages, components, and hooks for the NFT light-art portfolio app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light-art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, title, and mounting the React app at #root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes (gallery, artwork, upload, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections, using create/update mutation hooks with validation, loading states, and German-language toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of NFT collections with edit and delete actions, using a confirmation dialog for deletion and a modal dialog for editing via AdminCollectionForm.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT item, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and calling create/update mutation hooks on submit.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and edit/delete controls, using a confirmation dialog before deletion.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Presentational card component that displays a legacy artwork's image, title, and description with hover animations.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing its image, token ID, mint date, owner principal, and optional 'my NFT' highlight badge.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Top-level page layout providing a sticky header with logo, navigation, and login button, a main content slot, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a loading spinner during authentication and displaying toast notifications on success or failure.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top-level navigation bar component that renders route buttons for Home, NFT Gallery, Blog, Contact, and conditionally Upload and Admin links based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an NFT's image, title, collection name, price in ICP, and an optional ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component linking to an NFT collection's trade URL on Getgems, showing an image with loading/error states, title, description, and a 'Kaufen und Handeln' label.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven NFT collection cards (Lichtei, Wheel of Time, etc.) with Getgems marketplace links and local preview images.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal for an NFT showing its image, title, description, token ID, mint date, owner principal, and price, with copyable fields and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture for site visitors.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helpers to format timestamps and ICP prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Displays an ICP principal address with optional shortening, a tooltip showing the full value, and a copy-to-clipboard button with toast feedback.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of static blog posts about light health topics (wavelengths, blue light effects, red light therapy).
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend actor's addCollection method and invalidates the nft-collections query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that calls addNFT on the backend actor, then fetches and returns the newly created NFT, with user-friendly auth error parsing.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection by ID via the backend actor and invalidates both nft-collections and nft-items queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the backend actor and invalidates the nft-items query on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing the old artwork backend which has been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Stub query hook that always returns an empty array for backend blog posts, allowing static blog posts to still render.
Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: Query hook that fetches all issued ICRC-7 NFTs from the backend actor via listAllNFTs.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches all NFTItems from the backend actor via getAllNFTs.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy stub hook that always returns null, replacing the old single-artwork fetch from the deprecated artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy stub hook that always returns an empty array, replacing category-based artwork fetching from the deprecated artwork backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Stub query hook that always returns null for a backend blog post, deferring to static posts instead.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the currently authenticated user's profile from the backend actor, merging actor loading state into the returned query object.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's own issued ICRC-7 NFTs via listMyNFTs, enabled only when the user is logged in.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: Query hook that fetches a single NFTItem by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: Query hook that fetches all NFTItems belonging to a specific collection ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state management using DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the currently authenticated caller has admin privileges by calling the backend actor's `isCallerAdmin` method.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Hook that checks admin status with a 5-second hard timeout, resolving immediately to non-admin if unauthenticated or if the backend call exceeds the timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates related query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile via the backend actor and invalidates the current user profile query on success.
Stub mutation hook for the contact form that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items query cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook for artwork upload that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been superseded by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file validation, upload progress tracking, and uploading to the backend actor, returning the resulting `ExternalBlob`.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a warm art-themed light and dark color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that gates access behind authentication and admin-role checks, then renders tabbed UI for managing NFT collections and items.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message, as the original artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Displays a list of all blog posts by merging static and backend posts, with navigation to individual posts and an admin button to create new posts.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only form page for creating a new blog post with title, content, and optional featured image upload, redirecting non-admins back to the blog.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Renders a single blog post by ID, resolving it from either static data or the backend, with a back button and featured image display.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page that collects name, email, subject, and message, submits via a mutation hook, and shows success or error alerts.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page displaying a hero banner, a random Walter Russell quote, NFT collections, and an NFT explanation section.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT showing its image, title, description, price, collection badge, and a link to the ICP dashboard explorer.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: React page displaying an NFT gallery with tabs for all NFTs, issued NFTs, and the user's own NFTs, including wallet info, canister address banner, and modals for minting and viewing NFT details.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: React page providing a form for authenticated users to upload and mint new NFTs, handling image selection, progress tracking, collection assignment, and price input.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Utility function that copies a string to the clipboard using the modern Clipboard API with a fallback to the legacy execCommand approach for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, optionally truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom color tokens using OKLCH CSS variables, typography/container-queries/animate plugins, and custom keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing a fix request targeting the indefinitely-hanging admin permissions check screen, with three related feature IDs addressing useIsCallerAdmin, useActor, and AdminDashboard loading issues.
